name: Bonga shad
description: The bonga shad (Ethmalosa fimbriata) - by far the most abundant fish of the creek by biomass (nearly 25 tonnes per square kilometre in the 2003 model), a small clupeid that filters zooplankton and phytoplankton from the turbid water and feeds predators from ladyfish to sharks. Tracked as its own single-species compartment by the source.
